title: RTT Environment Block (v1)
description: Minimal environment substrate for RTTcode packets. Defines boundary conditions, ambient parameters, and drift thresholds required for coherent micro-regime evaluation. The environment is the observability frame — analogous to D369's structural boundary context.

_version_history.note: Metadata refresh — added _meta, _session_context, _version_history. No property changes.

boundary.description: Structural limits within which micro-regimes operate. Values outside the boundary indicate regime collapse.

min.description: Lower bound of the environment's allowable state space.

max.description: Upper bound of the environment's allowable state space.

ambient.description: Ambient conditions that influence resonance coupling and timing stability.

temperature.description: Ambient temperature or analogous scalar affecting micro-state stability. Higher values increase drift susceptibility.

noise.description: Environmental noise level affecting drift accumulation. Measured in the same units as the drift threshold.

drift.description: Drift thresholds and accumulation parameters. Drift is the silent structural degradation that D369 makes observable.

max_drift.description: Maximum allowable drift before coherence collapse. Exceeding this value signals regime transition.

accumulation_rate.description: Rate at which drift accumulates under current ambient conditions. Units per tick.
